snippet.title: Do. Not. Sleep... SLEEP AWAKE is Out Now
snippet.description:
SLEEP AWAKE is OUT NOW on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S along with the Original Soundtrack from Robin Finck of Nine Inch Nails.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2446540/SLEEP_AWAKE/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10011233
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/sleep-awake/9pf3t0m4hk95

In the last known city on Earth, people are disappearing in their sleep. Those who remain exist in a crisis of reckless experiments to keep awake. Navigate depraved death cults, otherworldly forces, and the ever-present horror of The HUSH, to save yourself and those who rely upon you.

#nineinchnails #narrativehorror #horrorgames #specopstheline
